title: My first game based in the celtic iron age
author: MorbilyABeast
selftext:
Hello all ! Ive been developing my game for the past 9 months. Started with a programmer 2 or ao years ago but decided to vibdecode it after we had some disagreements. Needless to say its been working so far. 200 soldiers working in unreal. And sandbox similiar to total war. 

Started coding this with claude , then switched to gemini , now im back to claude code. Its incredible how the tools have improved so much that before I was getting a lot of compile errors ik the beginning. Now it almost never throws an error. I feel so blessed as a non coder having the ability to mess around d with game design and mechanics. To even be able to develop a game and not break my brain completely to learn c++ from the ground up is a god send. Anyways id love for pro ai folks to check out my project. Im hoping I can show those that doubt a different perspective. Ai used as a tool in the hands of indies is not scary or villainous. Its the opportunity of a lifetime!

Wishlist and sing up for playtest this week !

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4881080/Koryos\_\_Sons\_Of\_Mars/

comments.author: TheDudeASMR
comments.body: Looks nice! What setup do you have that runs unreal?

replies.author: MorbilyABeast
replies.body: Thank you ! Im just on a 11gen I7 2.5ghz , with an amd rx6650, 32 g ram

comments.author: Impetigocheez
comments.body:
Your art looks great! Keep it up!! Love seeing this new wave of games made by people who have always had the ideas but not the ability to make it yet! I'm doing alot this year I never thought I was capable of.

  
And yes Claude Code is the superior coding system for sure!!

replies.author: MorbilyABeast
replies.body: Thanks man, im happy to be having fun and making what I want. So grateful for that !

comments.author: Reasonable-Ad-2070
comments.body: I like the idea! Its creative

comments.author: Impressive-Face-3549
comments.body: The ai content disclosure doesn’t really tell the customer anything. It just reads like a big word salad of your personal opinion on Ai, not what is actually ai generated, coded or used as a helper and what isn’t.

replies.author: MorbilyABeast
replies.body:
It is pretty precise. I will use it wherever I deem necessary and I will never remove or replace its in most cases. 

Steam asked where I used it and I listed code. Becuase it is all made in c++ using claude. 

Some UI elements are as well since I dont have a 2D designer. 


This exactly aligns with the disclosure. It will ebb and flow based on my needs. And my opinion is exactly outlined. Hope that helps :)

replies.author: Impressive-Face-3549
replies.body: I mean okay but again it’s not telling anything concerning what was specifically made with ai and what was done by you or whoever else. It honestly reads corporate speak regarding a topic without actually answering anything.

replies.author: MorbilyABeast
replies.body: Well you have to understand it is a hot topic and I think its more nuanced Than just listing the areas its used. I of course hold strong options as do man others about its use both negative and positive. The project uses AI. I dont think disclosing every time I have to use it for a different aspect of my game is a good use of time. People who dislike ai will have made ip their mind just by seeing the title of the disclosure and to me thats enough. It uses ai and will use it wherever necessary.
